pagerduty.command.help.title: PagerDuty Plugin Commands
pagerduty.command.help.description:
* **/pagerduty help** - Show this help message
* **/pagerduty schedules** - List all PagerDuty schedules
* **/pagerduty oncall** - Show who's currently on-call

You can also click the PagerDuty icon in the channel header to open the sidebar view.

pagerduty.admin.accessPolicy.intro: With no rule, everyone can use the PagerDuty plugin. With a rule, only users who match it get the PagerDuty button, sidebar and commands. The rule also applies to system admins; they can always change it here.
pagerduty.admin.accessPolicy.loadError: Could not load the access rule: {error}
pagerduty.admin.accessPolicy.unavailable: Attribute-based access control is not licensed or enabled on this server.
pagerduty.admin.accessPolicy.none: No access rule is set. Everyone can use the plugin.
pagerduty.admin.accessPolicy.noAttribute: No usable user attributes are available. Configure attributes (for example synced from LDAP or SAML, or admin-managed) before writing a rule.
pagerduty.admin.accessPolicy.editorMissi: The access rule editor is not available. It requires Mattermost 11.11 or later, which provides the attribute-based access control editor components to plugins. Update Mattermost, then reload this page.
pagerduty.admin.accessPolicy.removed: Access rule removed. Everyone can use the plugin.
pagerduty.sidebar.noAccess.title: You don't have access to the PagerDuty plugin
pagerduty.sidebar.noAccess.message: A system administrator has restricted this plugin to specific users. Contact your administrator if you think this is a mistake.
